# Netflix
> Streaming service for watching TV shows, movies, documentaries, and games across web, mobile, and connected devices.

Netflix offers subscription-based entertainment worldwide, including streaming playback, account management, device support, media information, investor resources, jobs, and a public developer-facing Open Connect platform.

## Watch and Browse
- [Browse](https://www.netflix.com/browse): Main browsing experience for discovering movies, series, and genres.
- [Latest](https://www.netflix.com/latest): Recently added and trending titles on Netflix.
- [Kids](https://www.netflix.com/Kids): Child-focused viewing area with family-friendly shows and movies.
- [Audio and Subtitles Browse](https://www.netflix.com/browse/audio): Browse titles by available audio and subtitle languages.
- [New and Popular](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/top10): Weekly Top 10 and popular Netflix title rankings via Tudum.

## Account and Membership
- [Your Account](https://www.netflix.com/YourAccount): Manage membership, billing, profile, and playback settings.
- [Login](https://www.netflix.com/login): Sign in to an existing Netflix account.
- [Signup](https://www.netflix.com/signup): Start a new Netflix membership subscription.
- [Redeem Gift Card or Promo Code](https://www.netflix.com/redeem): Apply a Netflix gift card or promotional code.
- [Change Password](https://www.netflix.com/LoginHelp): Get help accessing your account and resetting credentials.
- [Manage Profiles](https://www.netflix.com/ManageProfiles): Create and edit viewing profiles for household members.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://help.netflix.com/): Central support hub for account, billing, and streaming issues.
- [Contact Us](https://help.netflix.com/contactus): Contact Netflix support for account and technical assistance.
- [Supported Devices](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361): Device compatibility information for streaming Netflix.
- [How to Sign Up for Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/412): Steps for creating and starting a Netflix membership.
- [How to Change Your Plan](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/22): Instructions for switching between available Netflix plans.
- [Netflix Isn't Working](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/11639): Troubleshooting guide for playback and service problems.
- [How to Download Titles to Watch Offline](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/54816): Offline viewing instructions for supported devices.
- [Parental Controls on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/264): Set maturity ratings, profile locks, and viewing restrictions.

## Gift Cards and Billing
- [Gift Cards](https://www.netflix.com/gift-cards): Information about buying and redeeming Netflix gift cards.
- [Redeem](https://www.netflix.com/redeem): Redeem a gift card or promotional code to your account.
- [Billing Questions](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/41049): Help with charges, payment methods, and billing issues.
- [Update Payment Information](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116380): Manage or change your Netflix payment method.
- [Netflix Plans and Pricing](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/24926): Overview of available plans and pricing details.

## Devices and Apps
- [Netflix on Smart TVs and Streaming Media Players](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361): Supported smart TVs, sticks, and streaming boxes.
- [Netflix on iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116367): Setup and usage help for Netflix on Apple mobile devices.
- [Netflix on Android Phones and Tablets](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/57688): Installation and playback support for Android devices.
- [Netflix on Windows](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/23931): Watch Netflix on Windows computers and tablets.
- [Netflix on Game Consoles](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14164): Device support for PlayStation, Xbox, and other consoles.
- [Downloads and Offline Viewing](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/54816): Supported download features and offline playback guidance.

## Tudum and Editorial
- [Tudum](https://www.netflix.com/tudum): Official Netflix editorial site for news, features, and fandom content.
- [Top 10](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/top10): Weekly global and country-level Top 10 title lists.
- [Netflix Newsroom](https://about.netflix.com/en/news): Official company announcements and press releases.
- [Media Center](https://media.netflix.com/): Press materials, images, and media resources for Netflix titles.
- [Brand Site](https://brand.netflix.com/): Official Netflix brand assets, guidelines, and design resources.

## Open Connect and Technology
- [Netflix Open Connect](https://openconnect.netflix.com/): Public information about Netflix’s content delivery network platform.
- [Open Connect Overview](https://openconnect.netflix.com/en/): Overview of the Open Connect program and infrastructure.
- [Open Connect Appliances](https://openconnect.netflix.com/en/appliances/): Details about Netflix caching appliances for ISPs.
- [Open Connect Partner Requirements](https://openconnect.netflix.com/en/partner/): Technical and operational information for network partners.
- [Open Connect FAQ](https://openconnect.netflix.com/en/faq/): Frequently asked questions about Open Connect participation.
- [Netflix TechBlog](https://netflixtechblog.com/): Engineering articles about Netflix systems, data, and infrastructure.

## Company and Corporate
- [About Netflix](https://about.netflix.com/en): Corporate overview, company information, and newsroom access.
- [Company News](https://about.netflix.com/en/news): Official announcements, launches, and corporate updates.
- [Investor Relations](https://ir.netflix.net/): Financial reports, earnings, governance, and investor information.
- [Jobs](https://jobs.netflix.com/): Careers, teams, and open roles across Netflix.
- [Culture Memo](https://jobs.netflix.com/culture): Netflix culture and workplace principles.
- [Fast.com](https://fast.com/): Netflix-operated internet speed test for consumers.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://help.netflix.com/legal/termsofuse): Terms governing use of the Netflix service.
- [Privacy Statement](https://help.netflix.com/legal/privacy): Privacy practices and data handling information.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.netflix.com/YourAccount#cookiePreferences): Manage cookie-related preferences where available.
- [Corporate Information](https://help.netflix.com/legal/corpinfo): Legal entity and corporate contact information.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://www.netflix.com/yourinfo): Privacy choices for eligible users.
- [Legal Notices](https://help.netflix.com/legal/notices): Additional legal notices and third-party attributions.
